_comment: First-run onboarding: the short path through a new character's first ten minutes. Steps are ordered by `order` and retire the moment their own `condition` is already true against live state — there is no claim step and no dismissal. Condition kinds: skill_level, have_item, kill_monster, do_actions (skill_id+action_id narrows it; omit both to count every action), gp_total, quests_claimed. Every counter read here is one the game already keeps, so the guide can never disagree with the save. `route` uses the Screens vocabulary: a screen id plus optionally skill_id / action_id / area_id.

first_firewood.title: Fall your first tree
first_firewood.body: Open Timbercraft, choose Emberpine Tree and press Start. Let the activity finish ten times; logs go to Storage. You can stop or change activities at any time.

first_bar.title: Smelt a bar
first_bar.body: Open Delving and gather Copper Ore and Tin Ore. In Forgecraft, select Bronze Bar and smelt one of each ore into a bar. Make at least two bars for the next step.

first_weapon.title: Forge a weapon
first_weapon.body: In Forgecraft, select Verdigris Scimitar. It costs two Bronze Bars. Craft one, then open Storage or Equipment and equip it before combat.

first_fight.title: Win a fight
first_fight.body: Bring food and equip your weapon. Open Combat, choose Hearthfall Fields, and start a fight. Defeat a Scrub Fowl; watch your health and retreat if necessary.

first_gold.title: Earn 1,000 gold
first_gold.body: Earn 1,000 GP over time through activities, combat, rewards or selling items. Your lifetime earnings count; you do not need to hold all 1,000 at once. Spend gold at the Provisioner or General Store.

timbercraft_five.title: Reach Timbercraft 5
timbercraft_five.body: Return to Timbercraft and keep training until you reach level 5. Skill XP raises your level, which unlocks more activities. Your activity mastery is tracked separately.

first_task.title: Claim a task
first_task.body: Open Tasks, find an objective whose requirements you have met, and claim its reward. Completing an objective and claiming it are separate actions.
first_task.completion_note: That is the shape of it: gather, craft, fight, then come back to the Overview and follow what it suggests next.
